card.name: Just before abbreviations and file extensions
card.fires_on: Marks a spot right before an abbreviation, file extension or unit is about to be written, such as 'such as' before an acronym, a dot before exe or mp3, or the last digit before m 2 in 1.73.

modes.label: Before acronyms
modes.description: The words 'such as' or a separator right before an abbreviation or list of abbreviations.
modes.example: (abbreviations constructed from the first letters of several words, such<< as>> ADA for American Dental Association)

modes.label: Before file extensions
modes.description: A period or opening bracket just before an extension like exe or mp3.
modes.example: Click Compile to create your<< .>>exe shortcut file.

modes.label: Final digit of a number
modes.description: The last digit of a number just before a unit or isotope symbol, such as 1.73 m 2 or 1600 mg.

card.writes: It pushes toward odd short fragments and away from capital-letter unit abbreviations like MB and kB, so it adds no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires where a short abbreviation, file type or unit is about to follow.
